title: what is the aigamedev equivalent of DestroyMyGame
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
for my recent project, I really need a DestroyMyGame type of post except the sub doesn't allow ai games. 

is there an AI friendly equivalent of that sub? 

as much as I like spending time in this sub, I don't know this sub is really for getting gameplay feedbacks

any ideas? Thanks

comments.author: rainyengineer
comments.body: I see people having their game destroyed here all the time because half the content is pretty bad. Post your game and we’ll see.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I have been sharing the demo on this sub a few times already but here it is: [https://chooon.itch.io/signal-pit-bullet-hell-beasts](https://chooon.itch.io/signal-pit-bullet-hell-beasts) (you can download the steam version if you want controller support)

most of the feedback I get have been visual feedback; most people didn't bother to actually play. I think I have maybe <20 unique players so far

I like this sub but I don't think it is a good forum for getting people to actually play games

replies.author: DuckAndQwack
replies.body: I sure he didn't meant to post your game in reply to him, like make an another post about your game with it

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: oh I didn't want to spam the sub but I guess I can give it another try. thanks

comments.author: DatabaseConstant7870
comments.body: You could go to a vibecoders sub and have the majority of the comments shit on how it’s vibecoded even tho your in a sub for vibecoding

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
yeah that won't work either. I hang out in vibe coding subs too but it is mostly for lurkers. I run into other creators occasionally but that is not a forum for getting usable feedback too. 

the conversion rate from these reddit posts and the actual number of plays/downloads have been low.

I am surprised other aigamedevs aren't running into the same issue.

comments.author: Impetigocheez
comments.body:
I played the game for a bit and didnt even make it past one round. While the art is overall good, i like how you did the arena. the overall loop isnt that fun.  I think the fun of a bullet hell like game is from seeing lots of things die and I couldnt really tell if i I even hurt the other monster. 

I like the idea but it would almost work better like a turn based battle system or something. Or make more weaker enemies flooding you? 

Either way I know it took you a bit of time to make this! Keep at it!

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
I thought the idea of chipping away the monster's health is too easy so I added some health regen to all monster. that does make the game go a bit stale. 

the lack of weaker enemies dying does hurt the gameplay a bit too I think (I had the same question once I was studying other games)

well, with aigamedev, at least I didn't have to spent months to get to this point. It is still quite a challenge to try to make a fun loop

replies.author: Impetigocheez
replies.body: Absolutely man, I'm sure you'll figure something cool out :)

comments.author: Low-Cook-3544
comments.body: You could also try Discord servers for ai game dev or the specific platform you're building on! Lots of people on Discord are very keen to give you detailed feedback

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I am in the discord but it feels similar to the sub tbh. this isn't my first project. My last projects kind of went into the void when I promote in discord too...

replies.author: Low-Cook-3544
replies.body: Ah that's quite annoying... It depends on where you built your AI game as well I think. Tools like Rosebud or Bezi have pretty active servers where I've seen a lot of user feedback. But they could be pretty strict if your game isn't linked to their tools

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: that's a different dynamic because your game is ultimately serving their tool/platform. I suppose that's one way to get feedback (and then port the game out of their tool?) lol

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: How do they know its an AI begin to with?

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I have the ai disclosure on steam/itch

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Its kinda shitty that affects you. It should be that the sausage taste good, know how the sausage was made. But here we are.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
Yeah well, it is what it is

I ended up just spamming this sub and I eventually get some feedback that I need

I am still curious what other Ai gamedev do. I guess maybe they have friends/testers from discord etc. No idea
